embeds.title: ⛪ Raider Catholic Preferred Mass
embeds.description: Raider Catholic's **preferred Mass** is the **11:30 AM Sunday Mass at Old St. Mary**.

fields.name: 🤝 Why This Mass?
fields.value: Many Raider Catholic members attend this Mass together because it fits perfectly before our **1:00 PM meetings**. It allows everyone to go to Mass together and then head to the meeting right after.

fields.name: 🚶 Join Us
fields.value: If you would like to attend Mass with other Raider Catholic members, feel free to join us at this time!
